headline: Weathered Expanse, Stlican Shelf Flare as Stonecradle Quiets
war_summary: Morning wires to the 09:23 edition shift the weight westward, with the Weathered Expanse and Stlican Shelf both reporting three changes in two hours to the hour itself, the former standing five Warden to four Colonial amid 11,176 Colonial and 12,150 Warden losses in the day and quickening casualty rates about Crow's Nest and Frostmarch, the latter five Warden to four Colonial about Thornhold with 4,172 and 4,864 day losses. Stonecradle, busy overnight, logs seven affairs in six hours to 04:57 about Buckler Sound and The Reach to stand three Warden to six Colonial with 10,521 and 16,002 day losses, while Linn Mercy adds three in six hours to 06:15 about Lathair and Rotdust among twenty-two day affairs to hold eleven Colonial to none. Mooring County shows two affairs to 03:40 about The Wind Hills. Farranac Coast, Fisherman's Row and Gutter, lively to 01:57, 01:33 and 01:15, report no fresh flips in six hours. Callahan's Passage, Marban Hollow and Nevish Line list heavy day casualties with no changes.
